confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Lisbon price levels, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more stable than July accommodation rates, which are peak-season and volatile, so hostel and hotel anchors carry wider uncertainty. The FX observation came from search results that reproduce RBA data; the RBA page itself was not read directly in this session, so the figure should be confirmed against the official F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Lisbon-specific holistic estimates for July peak season, benchmarked against other Southern European capitals with strong summer tourism demand, such as Porto, Madrid and Seville.
